title: Cemetery-Blue Torch
summary: A light, simple melee torch that lights automatically when equipped. Deals 1d4 Bludgeoning plus 1d4 Fire while lit.

fields.Ignition: Can ignite flammable surfaces or clouds it contacts. The Fire rider ends when extinguished.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
